Frequently asked questions about Kolonie Kepler-7

Yes, everyone plays in the same galaxy. Join an alliance, develop an alliance base together, research alliance technologies, launch coordinated attacks and fight the world boss as a team. You can also trade on the market, form pacts with other players and compete on a shared leaderboard.

Yes. The game is completely free, with no subscriptions or paid gameplay advantages. Credits are earned in the game. Voluntary donations provide cosmetic items, not advantages in combat, production or leaderboard rankings.

Yes. Your queues keep working alongside resource production: when one building finishes, the next starts, and research follows the same rule. After at least 24 hours away, you also receive a returning-player production bonus.
Every successful administrator action with its time, target and details, recorded by the server when responding. Shows the latest 300 entries. Rejected attempts are not included.

Each faction has eight reputation ranks, its own missions, a shop and a rival that reduces your reputation when you help the other side. At rank 6 you may open an embassy, but only three slots are available.

Every battle has three phases and counter roles: fighters intercept bombers, bombers break capital ships, and destroyers clear fighters. Win chances are capped at 5-95% against NPCs and 10-90% against real players, so a smart formation can beat a larger fleet.

Do I need to download or install anything?

No. Kolonie Kepler-7 runs directly in your browser on PC, tablet and phone. No client, plugin or app-store installation is needed. On a phone, you can also add the page to your home screen to launch it like an app.

New colonies receive four days of beginner protection, and your nearest inhabited neighbour is deliberately far away. After that, PvP is part of the game: defences, shield modules and fleet formations help determine the outcome. You can lose resources and ships, but never your colony itself.
